description: Task 6: Code quality - add type hints and docstrings to all public functions in data.py, add OpenAPI summary/description to all endpoints in app.py, add py.typed marker file.
steps: 1. In src/augur/data.py, ensure ALL public functions (fetch_market_context, fetch_market_context_batch, fetch_history, fetch_market_overview, fetch_hot_tickers, search_ticker, calculate_technicals, clear_cache, cache_info, cache_stats) have complete type hints on all parameters and return types, plus Google-style docstrings.

2. In dashboard/app.py, add summary= and description= parameters to all @app.get/@app.post/@app.put/@app.delete route decorators. Use concise Chinese summary and brief English description. Example: @app.get('/api/analyze/{ticker}', summary='分析标的', description='Run 18 investor agent consensus analysis on the given ticker').
3. Create src/augur/py.typed as an empty marker file (PEP 561) to support mypy/pyright type checking.
4. Commit with message: 'chore: 代码质量提升-类型注解+docstring+OpenAPI描述 (v7.6.0 任务6)'

All route handlers in app.py have summary= parameter
